messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.
Write a brief academic-style statement distinguishing a legal boundary on a map from the way residents describe their neighborhood. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: Legal boundaries on maps represent rigid, administrative demarcations defined by statutory authority. In contrast, residents’ neighborhood descriptions are fluid, socially constructed narratives shaped by lived experience, cultural identity, and informal community interactions rather than precise geometric lines.
